title: Sundai sundae
description: The brand-book sundae on the building, its gradient drifting across the cup.

title: Sundai critters
description: The logo's pixel critters drifting up the tower.

title: Sundai reveal
description: The sundae builds window by window, holds, and fades.

title: Scrolling rainbow
description: Every window lit, hue drifting down the tower at 30 fps.

title: Bouncing bar
description: One row of colour bouncing between the top and bottom floors.

title: Sundai glow
description: Expanding rings of gradient light pulse outward from the sundae core, creating a shimmering halo effect.

title: Sundai arch
description: Four critters bounce across the building in arcing parabolic paths, crossing and passing each other.

title: Sundai melt
description: The sundae glass sits dim while bright gradient drips melt off its rim and tip and run down the tower.

title: Sundai sprinkle rain
description: Brand-coloured sprinkles rain down the whole facade like toppings falling onto the sundae.

title: Melting sundae
description: The sundae melts down the tower, drips pooling on the plaza, then re-freezes.

title: Cherry drop
description: A cherry falls into the sundae and splashes brand-coloured ripples across the facade.
